pages.name: Spanish: Open, Classical, 10.Nbd2 O-O 11.Bc2 f5 12.exf6
pages.notes: Overview and plans 2-3 rewritten and accepted (plan 2 had a ...c5 break blocked by the c6-knight; overview was generic). Plan 1 (targets an e6-pawn that is a bishop; routes the d2-knight through the f1-rook) is still wrong: two rewrites were rejected (Nb3 has no kingside role; knights on d4 and c5 do not eye d5, and Re1 is blocked by the e4-knight), so the old text was restored and its references added to the skips file.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Classical, 10.Nbd2 O-O 11.Bc2 f5 12.Nb3
pages.notes: Plan 1 named a d7-pawn that is not there; plan 2 named e6 as a pawn square; plan 4 used a Nb3-c5 route. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4 around Nfd4, Nc5 and ...Qd7. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Classical, 10.Re1
pages.notes: Overview called the e5-pawn isolated and a possible strength for Black; plan 1 had White pressing its own e5-pawn and Bf1 with no bishop able to go there; plan 2 had Black supporting e5. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3 around 11...Nxd4 and the Breslau 11...Nxe5. British spelling.
